_comment: Mound/area polygons traced from Vats 1940 Plate I (site plan) as rendered from the 1999 ASI reprint scan (data/artifacts/plates-source.pdf, PDF p.11) at 300 dpi (1749x1241 px). Coordinates are normalized 0-1000 (x = px/1749*1000, y = px/1241*1000), y growing downward. Polygons are APPROXIMATE hand tracings of the contoured mound extents / labeled areas - v1 'mound-level' precision. See ingest/georef.py for the pixel->WGS84 transform.
_source: Vats, M.S. 1940. Excavations at Harappa, Vol. II, Pl. I. 1999 ASI reprint scan.
_unmapped_values: Tabulation 'Mound or Area' values with no polygon (fall back to site-level): none->238 records, ''->27, plus rare values A, S, V, O, HH, II, IL, BT (1-2 records each; probable OCR noise or unlocatable micro-areas).

AB.label: Mound AB
AB.note: North-south ridge south of F, excavation sections I-IV. 49 seals.

B.label: Mound B
B.note: Small mound north of E, near modern grave yards. 16 seals. Approximate box.

C.label: Area C
C.note: Small area north of mound E. 1 seal. Approximate box.

D.label: Area D
D.note: Small excavation area at the south foot of Mound AB. 20 seals. Polygon is a small approximate box around the 'D' label.

E.label: Mound E
E.note: Large east-west mound east of AB. No seals in the Vats tabulation carry mound=E; included for completeness.

F.label: Mound F
F.note: Northwest mound; Great Granary complex. 265 seals.

G.label: Area G
G.note: Low flat area southeast of the site, near the Lahore-Multan road. 6 seals. Approximate box.

H.label: Area H (prehistoric cemetery)
H.note: Cemetery R 37 area between AB and E. 4 seals. Approximate box.

J.label: Area J
J.note: Small excavation area south of AB, east of D. 4 seals. Approximate box.

P.label: Great Granary area (Mound F)
P.note: Vats' 'Mound P' = the Great Granary excavation complex (trenches I-VI); confirmed by 'Mound P, Great Granary Area, Square J 9/20' (Vol I). 82 seals. Polygon covers the hatched excavation blocks on Pl. I; it lies inside F's footprint.
